questions.q: Scarlet Witch made her comics debut as a member of which team?
questions.why: Wanda debuted in The X-Men #4 as part of Magneto's Brotherhood, with her brother Quicksilver.

questions.q: Who is Scarlet Witch's twin brother?
questions.why: Wanda's twin brother is Pietro, the speedster Quicksilver.

questions.q: Which actress plays Wanda Maximoff in the MCU?
questions.why: Elizabeth Olsen debuted as Wanda in Avengers: Age of Ultron in 2015.

questions.q: In which year did the Disney+ series WandaVision premiere?
questions.why: WandaVision arrived in 2021 as the first Marvel Studios Disney+ series to focus on Wanda.

questions.q: In which 1975 issue did Wanda wed her android husband?
questions.why: Wanda's wedding took place in Giant-Size Avengers #4 in June 1975, a significant moment for the team.

questions.q: Wanda's magically created twin sons are later reborn as which pair of Young Avengers?
questions.why: Billy Kaplan (Wiccan) and Tommy Shepherd (Speed) were revealed to be the reincarnations of her lost sons.

questions.q: Who wrote the 2004 storyline Avengers Disassembled?
questions.why: Brian Michael Bendis wrote Disassembled, in which Wanda's rampage destroyed Avengers Mansion.

questions.q: Which Elder God infused Wanda with magical energy at her birth?
questions.why: Chthon, a demonic Elder God, imbued Wanda with his energy as a baby, intending to use her as a host.

questions.q: Who taught Wanda witchcraft starting in 1974?
questions.why: Agatha Harkness mentored Wanda in magic, expanding her power far beyond early hex effects.

questions.q: Which 2014 storyline revealed Magneto is not Wanda's biological father?
questions.why: Magneto had long been called her father, but the 2014 story AXIS revealed he is not her biological father.
